name: Kanojo-tachi no Dareka ga Netorareta
original_name: 彼女達の誰かが寝取られた
source:
This visual novel is about, one of the joys of cuckoldry:
the "surprise attack"

---- Who will be seduced? ---

A story from the point-of-view of three boyfriends (protagonist),
three couples in love that become a cucking in the second half.
But who? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE171237.html]DLsite English[/url]]
